rules.text: A change to headings 7401 through 7403 from any other heading, including another heading within that group.
No change in tariff classification for goods of heading 7404, provided the waste and scrap or wholly obtained or produced entirely in the territory of Singapore or of the United States.
A change to headings 7405 through 7407 from any other heading, including another heading within that group.
A change to heading 7408 from any other heading, except from heading 7407.
A change to heading 7409 from any other heading.
A change to heading 7410 from any other heading, except from plate, sheet or strip of heading 7409 having a thickness of less than 5 mm.
A change to headings 7411 through 7418 from any other heading, including another heading within that group.
A change to subheadings 7419.10 through 7419.99 from any other subheading, including another subheading within that group.

warning: Not updated for Pres.Proc. 8771, effective Feb. 3, 2012.
